sentences.text: Acrodus is an extinct genus of hybodont sharks named for its high and tooth characteristics.
It was a durophagous shark with blunt, broad teeth adapted for crushing and grinding hard food.
Some Middle Triassic species are suggested to have reached lengths between 1.8 and 2.5 meters.
The genus was described by Agassiz in Alberti in 1834.
Species inhabited both marine and freshwater environments, though all Middle and Late Jurassic forms are known only from freshwater.
